desc:
Portal Genius is a Rick and Morty inspired adventure: build your own portal gun, travel the multiverse and become the smartest genius in every dimension.

- Open portals to the Citadel, Cronenberg World, the Purge Planet, Toilet Planet, Froopyland and more
- Raise your IQ, research Rick's tech and craft gadgets: Mech Arms, Fly Implant, Twin Cannon, Meeseeks Box, Freeze Gun...
- Fight Evil Rick, Evil Morty, The Collective and Rick Prime, solo or with friends
- Live in the Smith house with Morty, Summer, Beth and Jerry, and grow clones in your secret bunker
- Fly Rick's saucer through space and land on other planets
- Start a faction and climb the IQ and kill boards

Play as Rick, Morty, Pickle Rick, Evil Morty, Rick Prime, Mr. Meeseeks and more.

Codes in MENU > CODES. Like the game and follow NADIRLEBOSSWw for new OP codes!
